violation_type.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs  - Fulcrum Seesaws (26 TAC §747.4405(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs  - Fulcrum Seesaws
violation_type.typical_finding: A fulcrum seesaw was present in the backyard and being utilized by children younger than 5 years of age during the inspection time.

finding_variants.text: A fulcrum seesaw was present in the backyard and being utilized by children younger than 5 years of age during the inspection time.
A seesaw was on the palyground where children play.
There is a see saw attached to the swing set.    There is also a see saw on the playground with four seats.

At the time of inspection a new fulcrum seesaw was present in the backyard of the home.
